name: Smith Machine Shrug
summary: A Smith machine variation of the shoulder shrug targeting the upper trapezius and levator scapulae along a fixed vertical track.

setup: Adjust the Smith machine bar height to approximately mid-thigh level.
Stand facing the bar with feet hip-width apart and grasp the bar with a shoulder-width pronated grip.
Rotate the bar to unrack it, standing upright with a braced core and arms fully extended.
steps: Elevate your shoulders straight up toward your ears in a smooth, controlled motion.
Pause for a brief contraction at the top of the movement.
Lower the bar under control until your traps are fully stretched back to the starting position.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you shrug your shoulders upward; inhale as you lower the weight under control.
cues: Shrug straight up to the ears.

common_faults.fault: Rolling the shoulders in a circle at the top.
common_faults.correction: Move strictly up and down along the vertical plane to prevent unnecessary glenohumeral stress.

common_faults.fault: Bending the elbows to pull the weight higher.
common_faults.correction: Keep arms straight and rely entirely on scapular elevation.

common_faults.fault: Jutting the head forward during elevation.
common_faults.correction: Keep the neck neutral and chin tucked throughout the set.

precautions: Ensure the safety catches on the Smith machine are engaged just below your lowest working range.
